summary: Open 3D cephalopod shell data are sparse: MorphoSource lists one Nautilus pompilius conch CT series (1,551 slices at 0.09 mm, 6.7 GB) and two ammonoid items, and Dryad has one Kosmoceras CT dataset with chamber volumes and suture photographs. No repository holding meshed septal surfaces with their attachment curves, or a sample spanning straight cones and sinuous sutures, was found.
next_step: Open the MorphoSource Nautilus CT series metadata (voxel spacing, whether septa resolve) and ask CT groups for ammonoid septal models; otherwise compile septal surfaces from published CT studies.
obstacles_confirmed: Downloadable CT is limited to Nautilus and a few ammonoid items.
Computer-designed septa on Dryad are theoretical, not measured.
The assumptions of uniform pressure and isotropic membrane are not recorded in any dataset.
